title: File:Mount Fuji from Lake Shoji (15443819010).jpg
claims: The image shows Lake Shoji in the foreground, a wooded shoreline and an autumn hillside at left, with the snow-capped cone of Mount Fuji filling the background under a blue sky.

The Commons file identifies Mount Fuji as seen from Lake Shoji; the FUJI100mi timing table names F3 Shojiko at 74.0 km, but the file has no camera coordinates, so the photograph is a lake landmark rather than a located aid-station scene.

The author is hoge asdf; the file is licensed CC BY 2.0; the original is 6,000 x 4,000 pixels and 17,184,147 bytes; the photograph was taken on 2014-10-25 at 15:12, uploaded to Commons on 2018-03-25, and sourced from Flickr; the file has no camera coordinates.
The route page uses a 960 x 640 copy of 192,179 bytes without cropping or colour change and credits the author, licence and source; attribution is required.
